test_case.test_name: Worst-case-ambient concurrent full-system thermal stress qualification
test_case.purpose: Demonstrate that the fully populated platform sustains the approved concurrent CPU, GPU, InfiniBand and E1.S full-power condition at the project-defined worst-case ambient for the complete formal soak without thermal warnings, faults, prohibited throttling or telemetry loss.
required_package: SUT population/topology plus cooling, fan, pump, PSU and firmware configuration manifest
Calibrated chamber, ambient sensor placement and approved setpoint/tolerance/ramp/stabilization/soak profile
Approved CPU, GPU, InfiniBand and E1.S stress packages, device mappings and utilization/power targets
Signed thermal, cooling, power, throttle, error and telemetry-completeness limits
Independent monitoring, emergency stop, cooldown and recovery procedure
test_case.test_command: After a qualified chamber operator confirms calibration, airflow/orientation, emergency shutdown and all runtime bindings, inventory every target and establish synchronized chamber, BMC, CPU, GPU, InfiniBand, E1.S, fan/pump/PSU and OS/SEL telemetry. Ramp and stabilize the approved ambient, start each approved workload against its explicit device mapping, prove every utilization/power target concurrently, hold for the full approved soak, and continuously evaluate warning/fault/throttle/error/telemetry-loss aborts. On completion or abort, stop loads in the approved order, cool to the recovery baseline and preserve all raw evidence.
test_case.expected_result: The complete population reaches and maintains every approved concurrent load target for the full stabilized soak; all chamber and platform measurements remain within signed limits; no thermal warning, hardware/cooling/power fault, prohibited throttle, workload error or telemetry gap occurs; and the platform returns to the approved stable baseline after controlled cooldown.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires the signed chamber profile and numeric limits, full-duration evidence, concurrent target attainment for CPU/GPU/InfiniBand/E1.S, complete synchronized telemetry, zero disallowed warning/fault/error/throttle event and verified cooldown recovery. Missing thresholds, shortened duration, a smoke run, CPU-only load, observation without loading, missing component evidence, telemetry loss or an abort cannot be called PASS. The end engineer owns the verdict.
safety_gate: A qualified chamber operator confirms calibration, safe airflow/orientation, emergency shutdown and approved ambient profile before ramp.
Verify all sensors, fans, pumps, PSUs, cooling loops and independent monitors before applying load.
Abort immediately on any approved limit, telemetry loss, cooling/power/component fault or uncontrolled temperature rise.
Do not auto-retry at temperature, suppress or clear warnings, or substitute a shorter smoke duration for the formal soak.
expected_evidence: Row/variant/hash and complete SUT population/configuration identity
Chamber calibration, sensor placement and ambient ramp/stability/soak timeline
Per-component workload command, package version, device mapping and utilization/power attainment
Synchronized chamber, BMC, CPU, GPU, NIC, storage, fan, pump, PSU, OS and SEL telemetry
Limit evaluation, warning/fault/throttle/error and telemetry-completeness report
Abort or orderly stop, cooldown/final baseline evidence and engineer-owned verdict
test_case.recovery: On a limit breach, fault, telemetry loss or workload error, preserve evidence, execute the approved immediate load-stop/emergency response, keep chamber control under the qualified operator, and cool to the specified safe baseline. Do not retry automatically; engineering must assess the event and separately authorize any rerun.
